scope: Paired OSM proxy-reference experiment; no certified absolute height or independent-city accuracy claim

all.interpretation: Production overview mixing splits; not holdout accuracy.

roof_plane_count_definition: Unique local plane equation signatures quantized at 0.001 in XY slope and 0.05m in height at footprint centroid; a complexity diagnostic, not structural correctness.
relative_height_definition: Adjacent fixed-grid height differences per metre; invariant to rigid vertical offsets, without shifting or aligning predictions to test references.
limitations: Official references span different LoDs and epochs and do not certify all real-world roof details.
Unknown reference support is not a confirmed absence; unsupported predicted geometry is reported separately.
Absolute-height losses and evaluation are off because exact vertical realization is unverified.
Boston relative shape and normal metrics use screened source support; DC has XY/plane-partition topology only.
Candidate bounds are independently optimistic local diagnostics, not realizable reconstructed models or inference outputs.
Visual cleanliness and reduced plane count do not alone establish accuracy.
limits: NAIP/3DEP use frozen2013-14 observations; OSM is a2026 snapshot and references may predate observations.
Boston source mixedLoD1.5/3 reference roofs are proxy supervision, not certifiedLoD2 ground truth.
Absolute-height loss and accuracy claims are disabled. Boston relativeheight/slope are limited to verified-metre reference masks; DC isXY/topology only.
Train/val/test are contiguous within-Boston parent-separated groups. These source regions were previously inspected, so this is not a blind external city benchmark.
GT is spatially cropped to OSM for supervision/display; introduced instance cuts are not true roof ridges.
Raw meshes and original point XYZ are unchanged; structural predictions use a custom derived geometric decoder, not native Roofer output.
The geometry control and new A/B routes share a frozen point-semantic prior. The geometry control has no newly trained structure network; it is not a strictly DL-free baseline.
Omitted uncertain components are conservative product decisions, not confirmed negative training labels.
Generated wall/ground faces belong to the algorithm output. Cropped reference remains roof-only; noGTwalls are inferred.
